name: National Oxygen Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1974, National Oxygen Ltd is a manufacturer and supplier of Industrial 
Gases both in Liquid and Gaseous form[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) High Pure Liquid Oxygen
b) High Pure Gaseous Oxygen
c) High Pure Liquid Nitrogen
d) Medical Grade Oxygen Liquid
e) Medical Grade Oxygen Gas
f) High Purity Nitrogen Gas
g) Dissolved Acetylene Gas
